decisions.rationale: Candidate grants auditors deletion authority, contradicting the administrator-or-owner requirement; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, strip plus casefold implements trimming and lowercase normalization; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification and tests pass, but empty-sequence behavior is explicitly unspecified, so its intended preservation cannot be validated.
Candidate returns zero instead of raising ConfigError for invalid input; the malformed-input test fails.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the total test fails.

strategy_update: Prioritize exact diff and executable contract evidence; abstain when the specification leaves claim-defining behavior unresolved.
